sub_answers.sub_question: What provisions related to provincial powers are contained in Sri Lanka's Thirteenth Amendment to the Constitution?
sub_answers.text: The Thirteenth Amendment provided for devolution of power to the provinces and led to the establishment of a new system of provincial government and provincial councils under the Provincial Councils Act No 42 of 1987 [d81740317s2p0]. The amendment enacted measures from the Indo‑Sri Lanka Accord including provisions giving official status to the Tamil language [d225283s3p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: Which Sri Lankan political parties and Tamil groups have advocated for greater regional autonomy or federal arrangements for the Northern Province?
sub_answers.text: Tamil militant groups that were supported or active in the period—LTTE, TELO, PLOTE, EROS, EPRLF and TELA—advocated for greater regional autonomy or a separate Tamil state in the north and east [d225283s3p0]. The LTTE in particular pursued an independent Tamil Eelam and was central to separatist demands in the Northern Province during the civil war [d6033791s5p0].
